clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Rendered Spores are being rushed from Apothecary Helbrim to Thunder Bluff before they decay. Apothecary Zamah must stabilize the emulsion beneath the city.

Apothecary Helbrim makes Rendered Spores from fungal spores gathered near the Barrens’ damp oases. He processes the strange spores into an active chemical emulsion, but it is unstable. After forty-five minutes, it breaks down and becomes useless for scientific study.

Apothecary Helbrim cannot finish refining the emulsion at his remote outpost. It must reach his Forsaken colleague, Apothecary Zamah, beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. In the Pools of Vision, Zamah has the equipment and reagents to reseal and finish processing the spores for the Royal Apothecary Society.
